name: Corrected Type-Token Ratio
description: The Corrected Type-Token Ratio (cTTR) is a variant of TTR that factors in the length of the speech/text sample. It calculates the ratio between the number of unique word types (distinct words) and the square root of two times the total number of word tokens (all words).

name: Root Type-Token Ratio
description: The Root Type-Token Ratio (rTTR) is a variant of TTR that factors in the length of the speech/text sample. It calculates the ratio between the number of unique word types (distinct words) and the square root of the total number of word tokens (all words).

name: Bilogarithmic Type-Token Ratio
description: The Bilogarithmic Type-Token Ratio (bTTR) is a variant of TTR that factors in the length of the speech/text sample. It calculates the ratio between the logarithm of the number of unique word types (distinct words) and the logarithm of the total number of word tokens (all words).
